seriesTitle: The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance

episodes.title: End. Begin. All the Same.
episodes.summary: In the land of Thra, a young guard discovers a terrible secret about the Skeksis overlords who control the planet -- and its powerful Crystal of Truth.

episodes.title: Nothing Is Simple Anymore
episodes.summary: As Deet sets out on her quest, Aughra awakens from a long journey, Rian flees the castle, and Brea searches for the meaning of the mysterious symbol.

episodes.title: What Was Sundered and Undone
episodes.summary: Brea struggles with her unsavory new duties, Deet and Hup get a hostile welcome from the Stonewood clan, and Rian begs his Maudra for help.

episodes.title: The First Thing I Remember Is Fire
episodes.summary: While Brea races to solve a puzzle in a hidden room beneath the throne, the Chamberlain hatches a plan to catch Rian and win back the Emperor's trust.

episodes.title: She Knows All the Secrets
episodes.summary: A missing Landstrider herd and an unexpected visit from the Skeksis put the All-Maudra on edge. Aughra summons Rian and the others to Dream Space.

episodes.title: By Gelfling Hand ...
episodes.summary: Lore breaks out of his chamber to help Brea. As news of the General's deed spreads, Seladon calls the other Maudras to the Citadel.

episodes.title: Time to Make ... My Move
episodes.summary: At the Circle of the Suns, the weary travelers receive an unsettling surprise -- and a lesson in Thra's history. The Emperor recruits a new army.

episodes.title: Prophets Don't Know Everything
episodes.summary: While Deet leads Rian on a harrowing journey through the tunnels of Thra, Seladon visits the Castle of the Crystal and sees a new side of the lords.

episodes.title: The Crystal Calls
episodes.summary: Desperate to save one of their own, the Skeksis make a deal with Aughra. Rian and Deet continue their search for the Dual Glaive.

episodes.title: A Single Piece Was Lost
episodes.summary: As the Gelfling and the Skeksis prepare for a fateful battle, the Scientist starts work on a new secret weapon.
